modern: Quarrels of little children and their games, and poor spirits carrying about dead bodies—such is everything; and so what is shown in the representation of the dwellings of the dead strikes our eyes more clearly.
original: Quarrels of little children and their sports, and poor spirits carrying about dead bodies [such is everything]; and so what is exhibited in the representation of the mansions of the dead strikes our eyes more clearly.
